#!/bin/sh
set -eu
cd /mnt/d/Physim
if [ "${1-}" != inside ]; then
 exec xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x1200x24' sh "$0" inside
fi
openbox --sm-disable > build/native/f1-linux-83-wm.log 2>&1 &
f1_wm_pid=$!
trap 'kill "$f1_wm_pid" 2>/dev/null || :' EXIT HUP INT TERM
python3 tools/build.py --config Debug --sanitizers --build-dir build/native/Design-analysis-linux --sdl build/native/F1-linux/sdl-install --jobs 4 --test-display --test-filter documentation_h --test-filter documentation_detail --test-filter documentation_sidebar --test-filter documentation_navigation --test-filter documentation_keyboard --test-filter documentation_scroll --test-filter documentation_window --test-filter documentation_history --test-filter documentation_panes --test-filter documentation_math --test-filter documentation_inline_math --test-filter documentation_zoom --test-filter documentation_density --test-filter documentation_font_demand --test-filter documentation_inline --test-filter documentation_typeset > build/native/f1-linux-83.log 2>&1

import hashlib,json,os,shutil,subprocess,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/mnt/d/Physim');out=root/'build/native/Design-analysis-linux/test-results/f1-83-h-storage'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
work=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='physim-f1-83-storage-'))
app=root/'build/native/Design-analysis-linux/bin/physim'
command=['/usr/bin/python3',str(root/'tests/check_display_workflow.py'),'documentation_h','--app',str(app),'--work',str(work),'--root',str(root),'--cc','/usr/bin/cc']
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
started=time.monotonic();result=subprocess.run(command,cwd=root,env=dict(os.environ),capture_output=True,encoding='utf-8',errors='replace',timeout=130)
record=dict(name='documentation_h',status='passed' if result.returncode==0 else 'failed',seconds=time.monotonic()-started,command=command,exit_code=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,binary=dict(path=str(app),sha256=sha(app)),original_work=str(work),storage_only_change=True,app_deadline_seconds=60)
(out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
shutil.copytree(work,out/'files ä')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in record.items() if k not in ('stdout','stderr')},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
